reason: Adopt the operator-authorized three-voter topology and AWS continuity demonstration while preserving strict serial execution.

acceptance_criteria: Phase A starts exactly three real Runtime v3 Guardian/kernel voters on Wuji and they converge in one authenticated trust domain.
Exactly one Phase A polis Observatory is shown live and identifies all three voters from one coherent redacted authority cut.
Phase A proves authenticated traffic, a governed distributed action, one-voter loss with retained quorum, recovery or truthful fail-closed behavior, and deterministic shutdown.
Phase B cannot start until every Phase A process, Observatory, port, lock, state lease, temporary credential, and test root is released.
After verifying profile agent-logic-admin resolves to the approved business account, Phase B starts exactly one Wuji voter and two independently stateful AWS voters in distinct failure units.

While all three hybrid voters are healthy, Wuji creates a majority-committed snapshot and both AWS voters verify its digest, trust domain, lineage, epoch, committed index, and restore eligibility before Wuji is stopped.

After Wuji is stopped, the two AWS voters preserve strict majority, fence the unavailable Wuji authority, observe the safety window, activate exactly one AWS owner, and complete a governed mutation without selecting an uncommitted local history.
Exactly one AWS-hosted polis Observatory remains live through Wuji loss and shows the failure, committed fence and epoch/index transition, active AWS owner, and continued coherent polis state.
A stale Wuji restart is rejected from mutation authority until an explicit governed rejoin or recovery transition completes.
Phase B terminates every ephemeral AWS compute, volume, network attachment, SSM session, credential, process, Observatory, port, lock, and test root, with machine-verifiable cleanup evidence.

Retained proof binds exact source, argv, node/process identities, nonzero tests, snapshot and committed-prefix digests, Observatory captures, serial phase transitions, AWS account identity, and cleanup predicates without secrets or private paths.

Fresh Gemini plan review and later independent exact-head implementation review have no unresolved actionable findings; the PR is not merged until the operator is shown both serial live demonstrations.

Implement quorum-committed snapshot replication, AWS restore eligibility, Wuji-loss fencing and activation, continued mutation, stale-Wuji rejection, and focused adversarial tests.
Run Phase A alone with three Wuji voters, show the single live polis Observatory, exercise one-voter loss and recovery, then prove complete teardown.

Only after Phase A cleanup, verify the AWS business account and run Phase B with one Wuji and two AWS voters; snapshot on Wuji, verify both AWS copies, stop Wuji, and show continued AWS authority and Observatory service.
Tear down all hybrid resources, validate exact receipts and cleanup, resolve independent implementation review, publish, shepherd CI, and merge only after operator demonstration approval.
